name: page-reach
description: Who-we-serve section of the 2026 company pages (Our Company, Figma 7450:97488): copy on the left (eyebrow, heading with a gradient phrase, paragraphs, an optional gradient highlight line between them, arrow links) beside a staggered stack of white stat cards (icon, small kicker, bold line, short text) over a dotted world map.

anchor.description: id on the section (letters, digits, hyphens).

eyebrow.description: Small uppercase label above the heading.

title_accent.description: Words of the heading painted with the brand gradient (first occurrence); must appear in title.

body.description: Copy above the highlight. Blank line = new paragraph; [label](url) links, **bold**.

highlight.description: One line in large gradient type between body and body_after.

body_after.description: Copy under the highlight (same markup as body).

links.description: Arrow links under the copy, stacked. Each: label, url.

cards.description: Stat cards, top to bottom (staggered on desktop). Each: icon (88px image URL; empty = no icon), kicker (small line), title (bold line), text (short line).

map.description: Decorative backdrop behind the cards (the dotted world map). Empty = none.

foot.description: Closing line centred under the copy and cards (Our Technology mobile section: From audits to equipment checkouts ...). Same light markup as body.
